sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% concentration for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Concerto for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 4. If Concerto is applied to allies as well, status ailments, debuffs, Cost reduction, and Unison gauge reduction will also be nullified based on the number of members (excluding self) in Concerto state).
[Unison Effect Boost] Changes the effect value of "Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds" to 200%.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000
Only [Bashful Beach] Blue Sea Riko can be used as Unlocking Potential material
